name: R4 finite-input sensitivity
stream_identity: stream_key = panel:statistic:stream_id; sorted lexicographically for PCG64 draws
universe: All original/additional stable and primary changed streams in D cut_search and E GLR. Joint vectors drawn once for sorted union; reuse across magnitudes, scopes, families, controls and omission fits. Stable-only masks changed-stream factors to one.
single_stream_selection: Sorted union of baseline global/foreign calibration donor ties, binding-constraint tuning ties in every selected full/omitted paired fit, and all checkpoint-808 tuning records. One vector with u=+1 and one with u=-1 per selected stream; all others zero. Run both scopes, including their identical single-stream scenarios.
path_transform: Multiply each complete available indexed statistic path by 1+epsilon*u. Keep abstentions and indices; derive maximum from the perturbed available values. Additional-stable paths are unavailable: multiply their maxima, never impute delays.
membership_order: Preserve recorded memberships.csv row order for every six/eight-member formula; complete original-stable calibration; omit whole checkpoint without changing retained divisor memberships.
selection: Stable-only fitting. Divide calibration maxima by recomputed full divisors; take maxima excluding target checkpoint. LOCO base=B_foreign*d_target; scaling-only base=d_target. For each fixed cap k select descending ratio position k+1 then max across constraints; increment multiplier toward +inf by nextafter until strict maximum>base*multiplier respects every cap. Reject invalid cap indices.
multiplication_order: (B_foreign*d_target)*multiplier for LOCO; d_target*multiplier for scaling-only; binary64, no rounding before decisions.
exports: All factors including one, recomputed divisors, fit summaries with all donor/boundary ties, primary and tuning paired decisions with available delays, signed crossing margin M-H and relative margin (M-H)/H. Other secondary changed records are not perturbation targets or reported sensitivity outcomes.
comparisons: Scaling-only versus LOCO on identical IDs; omission versus full restricted to identical retained IDs for each control; fit changes versus zero baseline. Counts, sets, stable identities and available delays are distinct.
zero_gate: Before nonzero scenarios, all selected full and omitted paired fits must exactly match historical reference binary64 thresholds, multipliers, candidates, ULP adjustments, global/foreign donor ties, boundary ties, all decisions and available delays; formulas reproduce supplied divisors exactly.
interpretation: Finite-input sensitivity on processed statistics only. No probabilities, confidence intervals, worst-case guarantees, population rankings or end-to-end precision claim.
forbidden_actions: editing historical numerical engines or schemas
